name: Brisbane Holiday Builder 🏙️
heroTagline: River city adventures, culture and outdoor fun — Queensland's vibrant capital is packed with family experiences.

region.description: A subtropical playground with world-class cultural precincts, stunning parklands, koala sanctuaries, and a buzzing food scene. The perfect city break for families.

areas.name: Brisbane CBD
areas.description: The heart of the city — Queen Street Mall, Botanic Gardens, CityCat ferries, and iconic laneway cafes.

areas.name: South Bank
areas.description: Brisbane's cultural and recreational hub — Streets Beach, Queensland Museum, GOMA, Wheel of Brisbane, and riverside dining.

areas.name: Fortitude Valley / New Farm
areas.description: Trendy dining and entertainment precinct — James Street boutiques, live music, and some of Brisbane's best restaurants.

areas.name: Hamilton / Northshore / Portside
areas.description: Riverside dining and cruise terminal — Eat Street Northshore food markets, Portside Wharf, and riverfront walks.

areas.name: Fig Tree Pocket / Indooroopilly
areas.description: Western suburbs — home to Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary and leafy riverside neighbourhoods.

areas.name: Brisbane Hinterland
areas.description: Day-trip to Mt Coot-tha, Mt Tamborine, and Lamington National Park — lookouts, waterfalls, and rainforest walks.

driving.parkingNote: CBD parking is paid ($15-30/day). Park at South Bank (cheaper) or use public transport. Many hotels include parking.

airportTransfer.familyShuttle: Approx. $50-$70 family return from Brisbane Airport to CBD.
airportTransfer.rideShare: Approx. $30-$45 from Brisbane Airport to CBD.

meta.priceAccuracyNote: All prices and costs are estimates generated on 2026-07-12. Availability and final pricing must be confirmed with each provider. The Brisbane Holiday Builder does not sell tickets, take bookings, or hold money.
meta.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by any listed accommodation, attraction, restaurant, or retail business. Logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
